feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: NCUA Seeks Public Comment on Draft 2027–2028 Budget
entry.summary: NCUA Draft 2027-2028 Budget Federal Register · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The National Credit Union Administration published its draft detailed business-type budget for fiscal years 2027 and 2028 for public review, as required by federal statute. The draft covers three components: the Operating Budget, the Capital Budget, and the Share Insurance Fund Administrative Budget. Public comments may be submitted through regulations.gov under docket NCUA–2026–2146 by November 30, 2026, and in-person statements may be presented at a November 17, 2026 budget hearing.

entry.title: CFTC and Kansas State University co-host AgCon 2026 agricultural futures conference in Kansas
entry.summary: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC and Kansas State University's Risk Management Center co-hosted the two-day 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. Panels covered the agricultural economy, derivatives market developments, farm credit, and risk management tools for producers. Topics included perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig attended and delivered the closing remarks.

entry.title: CFTC Sues Utah to Stop State Enforcement Against Regulated Markets
entry.summary: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has sued Utah to block the state from using state laws to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets. Utah had earlier filed civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. The CFTC says Congress gave it exclusive federal jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, including event contracts, and that it has also started legal proceedings against nine other states.

entry.title: CFTC to Publish Commitments of Traders Report Twice Weekly
entry.summary: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) plans to increase publication of its Commitments of Traders (COT) Report from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Monday data will be released Wednesday and Wednesday data Friday, both at 3:30 p.m. ET, cutting reporting latency from three days to two. The change follows a Request for Comment and aims to give agricultural market participants more timely trading position information.

entry.title: SEC order granting Cboe Clear U.S. temporary registration as a clearing agency for binary options
entry.summary: Cboe Clear U.S., LLC; Order Granting an Application, as Amended, for Temporary Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The SEC has issued an order granting Cboe Clear U.S., LLC (CCUS) temporary registration as a clearing agency under Section 17A of the Exchange Act. CCUS seeks to provide central counterparty services for binary options that are securities, and filed its application on June 30, 2026, amending it on October 1, 2026. The Commission will consider comments on that amendment before acting on permanent registration.

entry.title: Quarterly notice listing HUD regulatory waivers granted in early 2026
entry.summary: Notice of Regulatory Waiver Requests Granted for the First Quarter of Calendar Year 2026 Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto This Federal Register notice from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development lists regulatory waivers HUD approved from January 1 to March 31, 2026, as required by section 106 of the HUD Reform Act of 1989. It explains the legal requirements for waivers, such as written grounds and approval by Assistant Secretary-level officials. The provided text covers only the introductory portion, not the individual waivers.

entry.title: Notice establishing the Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization
entry.summary: Establishment of Federal Advisory Committees-Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The Department of Defense (referred to as the Department of War) announced in the Federal Register that it is establishing the Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization as a discretionary federal advisory committee. The notice estimates annual operating costs of $1,368,170, caps membership at 20, and lists the expertise areas from which members will be drawn.

entry.title: CFTC and NBA Sign MOU to Protect Basketball Integrity in Prediction Markets
entry.summary: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball CFTC · Oct 26, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association signed a Memorandum of Understanding to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Under the MOU, the two parties will share information by regularly communicating about integrity matters and maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agreement continues the Commission's commitment to expanding data sharing with professional sports leagues.

entry.title: Fee schedule amendment updating the definition of “trading platform” (Cboe EDGX, SR-CboeEDGX-2026-072)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Cboe EDGX Exchange to amend its fee schedule and update the definition of “trading platform.” The filing was made on October 19, 2026, and is effective upon filing under Rule 19b-4(f)(2). The notice invites public comments, to be submitted on or before November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Cboe BZX proposes updating its fee schedule definition of Trading Platform
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BZX Exchange filed a rule change with the SEC to amend the definition of "Trading Platform" in its fee schedule. The proposal adds a functional, use-based category covering any system through which orders of persons other than the operator are systematically executed electronically. Non-exhaustive examples include a broker crossing system not filed as an ATS, a systematic internalization system, and a decentralized blockchain-based or tokenized environment.

entry.title: Cboe BYX Exchange proposes updating its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” (immediately effective)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BYX Exchange filed a proposed rule change with the Securities and Exchange Commission to update the definition of “Trading Platform” in its fee schedule. The exchange states the change removes duplicative procedural obligations as a UTP trading venue, since the primary listing exchange’s information circular already provides members the same disclosures. The Commission waived the 30-day operative delay, so the change became operative upon filing, and public comments are invited through November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations (proposed rule)
entry.summary: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The Treasury Department proposes regulations to implement Subtitle C of the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, codified in Title VIII of the Defense Production Act. The rule would require U.S. persons to notify Treasury of certain transactions with foreign persons engaged in notifiable technologies, and prohibit certain other transactions with foreign persons engaged in prohibited technologies. It also adds applicability dates so the regulations continue to cover activities within the relevant timeframe. Comments are due December 7, 2026.

entry.title: SEC Releases Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities
entry.summary: SEC Announces Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities SEC · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The SEC announced the Division of Examinations' priorities for fiscal year 2027. The report highlights areas such as investment adviser fiduciary duties, retail investor protection, private funds and private credit, broker-dealer obligations, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. The priorities are not exhaustive, and the Division may adjust its focus during the year.

entry.title: IRS reminder to plan taxes year-round to make filing easier
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Year-round tax planning can make filing easier IRS · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The IRS encourages taxpayers to take simple steps now, such as checking withholding, organizing records, using IRS online tools, and protecting personal information, to prepare for the 2027 filing season. The attached Publication 5349-A, Year-Round Tax Planning is for Everyone, offers practical tips and IRS resources.

entry.title: OCC proposes new information collection for applications to issue payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Applications for Licensing or Registration To Issue Payment Stablecoins Under the GENIUS Act Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has proposed a new information collection for entities seeking to issue payment stablecoins in the United States under the GENIUS Act and has submitted it to OMB for review. The notice invites public comment on the collection's necessity, burden estimates, ways to improve clarity and reduce burden, and startup costs. Comments are due by November 23, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule on security measures for SNAP electronic benefits transfer cards
entry.summary: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Electronic Benefits Transfer Card Security Measures Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The USDA's Food and Nutrition Administration proposes changes to SNAP regulations to modernize Electronic Benefit Transfer technology and align it with consumer payment industry standards. The proposal aims to protect SNAP benefits from theft while keeping them accessible to approved households. Written comments are due by December 22, 2026.

entry.title: Publicis and LiveRamp: Proposed Consent Order Analysis for Public Comment
entry.summary: Publicis and LiveRamp; Analysis of Proposed Agreement Containing Consent Order To Aid Public Comment Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Trade Commission published a proposed consent agreement with Publicis and LiveRamp, along with an analysis explaining its terms and the complaint's allegations. entry.title: Proposed reporting forms for OCC-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers (public comment)
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Reporting Forms and Instructions for Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuers Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has published a notice proposing a new information collection, titled "Reporting Forms and Instructions for Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuers Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency." It would include weekly and quarterly reporting forms for permitted and foreign payment stablecoin issuers. The OCC is seeking a new OMB control number and has sent the collection to OMB for review; comments are due by November 23, 2026.

entry.title: US Stablecoin Rules: OCC Regulations for Stablecoin Issuance by Supervised Entities
entry.summary: Implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act for the Issuance of Stablecoins by Entities Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuance and related activities by entities under its jurisdiction. The rule takes effect January 18, 2027, and addresses about 328 comments received on the March 2026 proposal.

entry.title: Treasury Request for OMB Review of U.S. Information Return Forms and Related Guidance Collection
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; U.S. Information Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Department of the Treasury is submitting an information collection covering U.S. information returns, such as Forms 1099 and 1098, along with related forms, schedules, attachments, and published guidance, to the Office of Management and Budget for review. The notice explains how the Paperwork Reduction Act approval and burden estimates apply to this collection. The public may submit comments by November 23, 2026.

entry.title: IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect your tax information
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect tax information IRS · Oct 22, 2026 The IRS urges taxpayers to guard their online-account credentials and obtain an Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN) to help prevent tax-related identity theft. The IRS Individual Online Account holds sensitive data such as filed returns, refund status and tax records. An IP PIN is a six-digit number that blocks others from filing federal returns using a taxpayer's SSN or ITIN. Taxpayers planning to file early in 2027 should request one before the mid-November annual maintenance.

entry.title: Treasury and IRS update retirement plan correction program and create one for IRAs
entry.summary: Treasury, IRS update retirement plan correction program and establish correction program for individual retirement accounts IRS · Oct 22, 2026 The Treasury and IRS issued two revenue procedures: Revenue Procedure 2026-34 updates the EPCRS correction program for employee retirement plans, effective immediately, and Revenue Procedure 2026-33 creates the IRA Compliance Resolution System, effective May 1, 2027. Both programs are open for public comment, and the IRS says the new system lets IRA custodians and owners correct certain service-provider errors.

entry.title: Cboe EDGX proposal to amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4 for listing options on crypto commodity trusts and exchange-traded funds
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 19.3 and Rule 19.4 To Establish Generic Listing Criteria and Continued Listing Standards for Options on Commodity-Based Trusts Holding Multiple Crypto Assets and To Permit the Listing of Options on Exchange-Traded Funds Federal Register · Oct 22, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a Cboe EDGX Exchange proposed rule change that would amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4. It would set generic listing and continued listing standards for options on shares of commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets, and permit options on exchange-traded funds as defined under Rule 6c-11. Public comments are invited until November 12, 2026.

entry.title: CFTC Obtains Court Order Requiring Louisiana Man and Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud CFTC · Oct 21, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced that the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC. The court found they fraudulently solicited and misappropriated over $3 million from participants in a retail forex scheme. The order requires a $9,211,492 civil penalty, permanently enjoins further Commodity Exchange Act violations, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans.

entry.title: IRS Temporary Relief From Reporting and Recordkeeping for Certain Fuel Uses
entry.summary: Temporary reporting and recordkeeping relief for certain fuel uses IRS · Oct 21, 2026 The IRS announced temporary administrative relief from reporting and recordkeeping requirements tied to taxes under Internal Revenue Code section 4041(a). The relief covers taxable uses of dyed diesel occurring from October 1, 2026 through before January 1, 2027. During this period, the IRS will not challenge or assert civil penalties solely for failures covered by the announcement. Obligations for other liabilities and separate claims are unaffected.

entry.title: State Justice Institute FY 2027 grant guideline notice
entry.summary: Grant Guideline; Notice Federal Register · Oct 21, 2026 · Crypto The State Justice Institute published its grant guideline for fiscal year 2027, setting out administrative, programmatic and financial requirements for its grants. It covers eligibility for state and local courts and other organizations and lists quarterly application deadlines of November 1, February 1, May 1 and August 1.

entry.title: Member/Shareholder Notification of Share Insurance (Proposed Rule)
entry.summary: Notification to Members/Shareholders Federal Register · Oct 21, 2026 · Crypto The NCUA Board seeks public comment on a proposal to streamline how federally insured credit unions notify members of share insurance coverage. The current rule mandates certain hard-copy materials, while the proposal would let credit unions choose the notification method, including a link to updated online resources maintained on the NCUA website. Comments are due by December 21, 2026.

entry.title: CFTC Innovation Task Force Releases Agenda and Panelists for Inaugural Super Intelligence Forum
entry.summary: CFTC’s Innovation Task Force Announces Agenda & Panelists for Inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence CFTC · Oct 21, 2026 The CFTC's Innovation Task Force released the agenda for its first Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence. Discussions will cover how super intelligence is being implemented at the frontier, its effects on U.S. markets, and the Commission's role in fostering responsible adoption while protecting market participants from emerging risks. The meeting will be streamed live on CFTC.gov.

entry.title: SEC and French AMF Sign Supervisory MOU to Boost Cooperation on Investment Advisers and Service Providers
entry.summary: SEC and AMF Announce Supervisory MOU To Enhance Cooperation for Investment Advisers and Investment Service Providers SEC · Oct 20, 2026 The U.S. SEC and France's Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to facilitate consultation and information-sharing in supervising certain investment advisers, investment companies, and investment service providers. The MOU sets out a framework for cooperation and information exchange for firms operating in the U.S. and France. It also facilitates SEC registration and supervision of AMF-supervised asset management companies seeking to act as investment advisers in the United States, and the SEC will process new and pending applications under this arrangement.

entry.title: US SEC and Japan FSA Hold Autumn Financial Regulatory Dialogue
entry.summary: SEC, FSA Hold Autumn Financial Regulatory Dialogue SEC · Oct 20, 2026 The U.S. SEC and Japan's Financial Services Agency met in Tokyo on October 19, 2026, for their Autumn Financial Regulatory Dialogue, building on long-running cooperation. Participants discussed recent market developments, each authority's strategic priorities, and regulatory matters including private and public markets, asset management, and innovation. The next dialogue is scheduled for spring 2027 in Washington, D.C.

entry.title: SEC to Hold Roundtable on Machine-Readable Data and Super Intelligence
entry.summary: SEC Announces Roundtable on Machine-Understandable Data in the Age of Super Intelligence SEC · Oct 20, 2026 The SEC announced it will host a roundtable on November 9, 2026, to discuss the use of machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence, along with related risks and costs. The event is open to the public at SEC headquarters and will be streamed live on SEC.gov.

entry.title: CFTC Secures Court Orders for Former Long Island Resident and Firm to Pay Over $288 Million in Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his company EminiFX Inc. to pay over $288 million, including $228,576,962 in restitution to defrauded investors, $15,049,500 in disgorgement of unlawful gains, and a $45,148,500 civil penalty. The order states EminiFX posed as an investment club promising weekly returns of 5% to 9.99% and was a Ponzi scheme. As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors.

entry.title: Further Definition of “Swap” Excluding Casino-Style Gambling Products
entry.summary: Further Definition of “Swap” To Exclude Casino-Style Gambling Products Federal Register · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC issued an interim final rule codifying its longstanding position that casino-style gambling products, including wagers on sportsbooks and casino games, are excluded from the definition of “swap.” The rule took effect October 19, 2026, and comments are due by November 18, 2026.

entry.title: IRS announces 2026 Tax Professional Awareness Week with resources for the 2027 filing season
entry.summary: IRS announces 2026 Tax Professional Awareness Week, highlighting resources to help tax professionals prepare for the 2027 filing season IRS · Oct 16, 2026 The IRS announced Tax Professional Awareness Week, held the week of October 19, offering webinars, videos, guidance and tools. Resources aim to help tax professionals prepare for the 2027 filing season, support accurate returns and protect taxpayer information. An October 21 webinar on refundable credits is scheduled.

entry.title: IRS begins automatic refunds for individuals with prior-year Adoption Tax Credit carryforwards
entry.summary: IRS has begun issuing automatic refunds to individuals who claimed Adoption Tax Credit carryforward from prior years IRS · Oct 16, 2026 The IRS has started issuing refunds to more than 50,000 taxpayers who used Adoption Tax Credit carryforwards and expects most eligible refunds to be completed by year end. Following a Treasury clarification of the Working Families Tax Cuts, for tax year 2025 only, carryforwards from 2020 to 2024 can increase the refundable amount, subject to the $5,000 per qualifying child limit. Affected taxpayers do not need to file an amended return and will receive notices about their adjustments.

entry.summary: Senior Executive Service Performance Review Boards Federal Register · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto This October 16, 2026 Federal Register notice announces the members of Senior Executive Service Performance Review Boards at the Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service. The boards review senior executives' performance appraisals and recommend ratings, pay adjustments, and performance awards to the appointing authority. The notice also includes an OFAC action removing one individual from the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and unblocking his property.

entry.title: SEC Approves Cboe Proposal to List Binary Options on Issuer Key Performance Indicators
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To Permit the Listing of Binary Options Overlying Key Performance Indicators Reported by Certain Issuers of Stock Federal Register · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission published a notice and order concerning a rule change filed by Cboe Exchange, Inc. The amended proposal would allow the exchange to list binary options overlying key performance indicators reported by certain stock issuers, with payout being all-or-nothing at expiration. The Commission sought comment on Amendment No. 1 and approved the rule change, as modified, on an accelerated basis.

entry.title: Proposed Amendments to Investment Company Cross Trading Rule
entry.summary: Investment Company Cross Trading Federal Register · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The SEC proposes amending rule 17a-7 under the Investment Company Act, which permits certain cross trades between registered funds and affiliates subject to conditions. The amendments would expand eligible securities, modernize the rule's conditions, and enhance investor protection. The proposal also requires aggregated reporting of trading activity and cross trades on Form N-PORT and Form N-MFP. Comments are due December 14, 2026.

entry.title: SEC Advisory Committee to Discuss IPO Modernization and Crowdfunding Rules
entry.summary: SEC Small Business Advisory Committee to Discuss IPO Modernization and Regulation Crowdfunding SEC · Oct 14, 2026 The SEC's Small Business Capital Formation Advisory Committee will meet on October 27, 2026, to continue discussing IPO modernization and possible changes to Regulation Crowdfunding. The morning session will address ways to encourage more companies to go public, while the afternoon session will review the current Reg CF framework, its successes and challenges. The meeting is open to the public and will be streamed live on SEC.gov.

entry.title: IRS offers dyed diesel excise tax relief following presidential executive order
entry.summary: IRS provides dyed diesel fuel relief related to excise tax following President Trump’s Executive Order IRS · Oct 14, 2026 The IRS announced that, following a President's October 5, 2026 executive order, it will not penalize sales or use of dyed diesel fuel on highways nationwide. The relief runs from October 1 through December 31, 2026. During this period, ordinary collection and enforcement procedures are suspended, and no federal inspections of on-road dyed fuel use will occur. The relief applies only to federal tax and does not affect state fuel taxes.

entry.title: Proposed rules tighten Premium Tax Credit eligibility to curb fraud and improper claims
entry.summary: Treasury and IRS move to protect health care benefits for eligible Americans IRS · Oct 14, 2026 The Treasury Department and IRS proposed regulations implementing Working Families Tax Cuts reforms to the Premium Tax Credit, a refundable credit that helps eligible taxpayers afford Exchange health insurance. Beginning in 2027, eligibility would be restricted to U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, and certain lawfully present noncitizens, with new verification criteria for advance payments.

entry.summary: Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets Federal Register · Oct 13, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking seeking public comment on its intent to develop rules implementing section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act for crypto asset transactions and markets. Comments are due by December 14, 2026. The excerpt provided covers only the summary, dates, and addresses, so the specific proposed rule content is not described.

entry.title: CFTC seeks comment on proposal to define certain event contracts as swaps
entry.summary: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Concerning the Inclusion of Certain Event Contracts in the Definition of Swap CFTC · Oct 10, 2026 The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission published a proposed rule that would expressly include event contracts, such as those based on sports, politics, culture, and weather, within the definition of “swap.” The proposal says these contracts are commonly known as swaps and aims to resolve any ambiguity. Written comments must be submitted via Regulations.gov within 30 days of Federal Register publication.

entry.title: CFTC issues interim final rule excluding certain gambling activity from the swap definition
entry.summary: CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule Excluding Certain Activity from the Definition of Swap CFTC · Oct 10, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an interim final rule codifying that casino-style gambling products, including sportsbook and casino game wagers, are excluded from the definition of "swap." The rule takes effect upon publication in the Federal Register. Written comments must be submitted via Regulations.gov within 30 days of that publication.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds
entry.summary: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds SEC · Oct 9, 2026 The SEC proposed amendments to the Investment Company Act cross-trading rule (Rule 17a-7) that would let registered funds cross trade more securities with affiliates, including most fixed-income securities. The changes would also modernize the rule's conditions and require aggregated reporting of trading activity and cross trades on Forms N-PORT and N-MFP. Comments are due on or before December 14, 2026.

The second proposes revising the National Credit Union Administration's Call Report (Form 5300) to collect data on credit unions' payment stablecoin activities, effective with the March 31, 2027 report date.
